domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the taxation of individuals, including income sources, allowances, and the calculation of personal tax liabilities. Candidates must demonstrate a clear understanding of how these specific tax rules apply to various personal financial scenarios and individual taxpayer obligations.

This domain focuses on the tax obligations of limited companies, including the calculation of taxable profits and corporate tax liabilities. Candidates are expected to master the technical requirements for reporting company profits and ensuring compliance with all relevant corporate tax regulations.

This domain addresses the taxation of gains arising from the disposal of assets by individuals and corporate entities. It requires candidates to accurately compute chargeable gains and understand the reporting requirements associated with the disposal of various types of business assets.

This domain covers the administration and calculation of Value Added Tax, including registration requirements and return submissions. Candidates must be proficient in managing VAT compliance, calculating tax liabilities, and understanding the administrative processes involved in maintaining accurate VAT records for businesses.

faq.answer_text: To pass the Taxation (TX/F6) exam, candidates must achieve a score of 50 percent. This benchmark is strictly enforced to ensure that all certified professionals possess the required level of technical knowledge and competency in tax regulations for their future accounting career.

The exam duration is 180 minutes. Candidates should practice managing their time across the various sections to ensure they can answer all questions within this timeframe while maintaining the accuracy required to reach the passing score of 50 percent before the final retirement.

The price for the exam is 202 dollars. Candidates should verify this fee through official ACCA channels before scheduling their assessment to ensure they have the most current information regarding payment requirements and registration procedures for the Taxation (TX/F6) certification exam.

editorial.overview: Taxation (TX/F6) is an ACCA certification covering the principles of tax systems. It examines personal income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, and VAT. This linear exam uses objective test questions and constructed response tasks to assess technical knowledge. As this exam is scheduled for retirement on 2027-06-30, candidates are directed toward the successor, E1 (Managing Finance in a Digital World), for their professional development path. This assessment ensures that all candidates demonstrate the necessary proficiency in tax regulations required for modern accounting roles within the global financial sector.
editorial.preparation_strategy: To prepare, use current revision kits from ACCA-approved publishers to practice objective test questions and constructed response tasks. Watch official lectures and review technical articles to understand tax changes. Since the exam is a 180-minute linear assessment, consistent practice with exam-standard questions is necessary to reach the 50 percent passing score. Ensure you are ready for the retirement date of 2027-06-30 by completing all required study modules well in advance of the final deadline.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam is for accounting students and professionals seeking to demonstrate proficiency in tax regulations. It is suitable for those pursuing the ACCA qualification who need to master tax computations and compliance before the exam retires in 2027.

exam_rules: Closed-book. Scientific calculators permitted (non-programmable, non-financial). No graphical or financial calculators. No phones or electronic devices. Scratch paper provided.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID required. Name on ID must match ACCA registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: ACCA retires TX/F6 on 2027-06-30. E1 is the named replacement path.

renewal_options: Passed exams do not expire. Once qualified, ACCA members must complete 40 CPD hours per year (21 verifiable hours minimum). Annual membership subscription required to maintain active ACCA status.

retake_policy.notes: Maximum 4 attempts per exam in total for Applied Knowledge CBEs (on-demand). Applied Skills and Strategic Professional: 4 exam sessions per year (March, June, September, December). Full exam fee required for each retake.

testing_centers.notes: Computer-Based Exams (CBE) at Pearson VUE test centers globally; paper-based exams available in some regions
